blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five views and six poses shows the overskirt remains a smooth flared shell; the six sewn pleats are not legible at product-view scale.
Reducing skirt-envelope clearance from 10 mm to 4 mm aligns it with the bodice and waistband settings, but left/right views still show an abrupt projecting shelf where the overskirt joins the bodice.
Crouch and sit show stiff panels intersecting the thighs and hanging unevenly; prone compresses the skirt into broad lobes. Pose response remains incoherent.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
